title: Precision-blend calibration ladder for FP8 on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Deliver a robust multi-stage 'precision-blend' calibration ladder to safely adopt FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) on Hopper GPUs for production inference. This ticket codifies the calibration workflow, stability mitigations, and validation harness needed to (1) measure per-layer sensitivity across representative prompts, (2) produce deterministic per-op precision blends (mix E4M3/E5M2/INT8 where beneficial), and (3) provide automated fallback triggers tied to telemetry and QA gates. The approach emphasizes reproducible sweeps, conservative hysteresis, and a staged rollout path (shadow -> dark-launch -> canary -> broad).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible calibration pipeline exists that produces per-layer precision recommendations for E4M3 vs E5M2 vs INT8 for target models (LLama2-13B, RedModel-7B).
Calibration ladder produces a ranked candidate set and a certified 'safe' profile for at least two production workloads with parity loss <= 1% on golden evaluation prompts.
Automated telemetry rules (Grafana alerts / SLO hooks) trigger fallback to INT8 or hosted-host fallback when detected degradation crosses thresholds defined in this ticket.
End-to-end integration test in CI that runs a smoke calibration sweep and verifies rollback path via config toggles.
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Spike complete — micro-sweep harness implemented (python/sweep) to run per-op scale trials and collect L2-norm drift and output token delta metrics (PR prototype: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4721).
2026-03-04: Built golden prompt set (400 prompts) stratified by length/semantic-type and stored in S3 (s3://redwood-quant/golden/precision-blend/).

2026-03-07: Initial multi-model runs show systematic instability for E4M3 on self-attention key projections at long context (>2k tokens) — added noise-injection experiment and hysteresis window in the ladder.
2026-03-09: Telemetry gating thresholds drafted; created Grafana dashboard (dashboards/FP8-PrecisionBlend) and deployed shadow config to 5% of traffic in staging.
decisions: Adopt a ladder with 3 phases: COARSE (per-layer aggregated stats), FINE (per-op micro-sweeps), and VERIFY (shadow traffic + golden-set eval).
Default safe-profile will prefer E5M2 for attention projections when long-context usage > 1.5k or when variance > 0.02 normalized delta metric.
Fallback policy: automatic fallback to INT8 for model shards where per-op validation fails statistical significance tests (p < 0.01) against golden-set results.
Calibration outputs will be stored as immutable artifacts (s3) and checksumed; profiles are versioned and pinned in the model registry.
review_feedback: Diego Martinez (PM): emphasize rollout conservatism and add explicit customer-facing opt-out flag for FP8 in runtime configs.
Sofia Patel (Applied ML): request to include KL-divergence and token-level perplexity as part of the VERIFY stage metrics.
Ethan Li (SRE): telemetry must include per-shard CPU/GPU utilization and tail latency buckets; gating should avoid cascading circuit breakers during infra noise.
test_plan: Unit: synthetic per-op scale tests with mocked kernels to assert calibration pipeline logic (CI job: quant-calib-unit).
Integration: run calibration ladder on canary models in staging with 10k shadow requests; compare golden-set metrics and store artifacts.
Performance: measure median and p95 token latency across precision-blend profile vs baseline INT8 and FP16 on Hopper instance types.
Regression: add golden-set nightly job and block release if accuracy drop > 1.5% over baseline for 3 consecutive days.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (dev): run full ladder offline and produce candidate profiles (internal only).
Stage 1 (shadow): apply profile in shadow mode to 5% of staging traffic for 72h; gather telemetry and golden-set metrics.
Stage 2 (dark-launch canary): route 1% production traffic to profile with automatic abort if thresholds breached.
Stage 3 (canary ramp): 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual checkpoint at each step and 24h observation windows.
risks: FP8 numeric corner cases causing silent semantic drift on rare prompt families (classification/QA).
Too-aggressive automatic fallback could cause oscillation if telemetry is noisy; mitigated via hysteresis and multi-window checks.
Long calibration runtimes may delay deployments; addressed by progressive sampling and reusing cached per-shard statistics.
rollback_plan: Immediate revert via runtime flag to 'safe-profile' (INT8-dominant) if alerts trigger.
Automated schedule to re-run calibration with tighter constraints and report differences; open follow-up ticket if persistent failure.
Operational runbook entry created for on-call to coordinate customer notifications and SLA adjustments.
